title_zh: 约定按时间线重写虚构案件摘要

scenario.label_zh: 区分虚构案件中的拘留与案件驳回
scenario.goal_zh: 区分拘留事实与后来的案件驳回，并约定不把拘留写成有罪证明

context_zh: 学生与教师依据虚构法律案例材料修改课堂摘要；不是现实法律咨询。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: The case summary says officers decided to detain the driver overnight. Does that mean he was found guilty?

sentences.speaker: Mr Cole
sentences.text: No. The file records his detention, but that is not a guilty verdict.

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: There is also a dismissal of the case two weeks later. Should that go in the opening sentence?

sentences.speaker: Mr Cole
sentences.text: It needs to appear clearly. Your current opening leaves readers thinking the accusation was proved.

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: I will put the events in order: detention that night, then dismissal two weeks later.

sentences.speaker: Mr Cole
sentences.text: Good. Keep the accusation separate from any finding, and do not invent a conviction.
